prompt: What is the exact value of $\sin 30^\circ$? Give a fraction or decimal.

hints.text: The side opposite $30^\circ$ is $1$ and the hypotenuse is $2$.

explanation: The $30$-$60$-$90$ triangle has sides in the ratio $1 : \sqrt{3} : 2$, with $1$ opposite the $30^\circ$ angle.

alternativeExplanations.title: Fold an equilateral triangle
steps: Take an equilateral triangle with sides of length 2 and cut it down the middle.
The cut makes two $30$-$60$-$90$ triangles whose short side is half of the original side, or 1.
That short side sits opposite the $30^\circ$ angle, so $\sin 30^\circ = \frac{1}{2}$ — literally "half".
